content: Synth/sound-design pedagogy (MusicTech, Soundfly, Syntorial, ModWiggler forum) recommends deliberate practice via patch-recreation: reproduce iconic/commercial patches by ear to reverse-engineer signal flow and parameter interaction, and always design patches against a beat/track context rather than in isolation to avoid overly frequency-rich, context-blind sounds. Syntorial is a dedicated ear-to-synthesis-parameter training tool.
